name: Ricardo Flores
bio:
Ricardo's journey into motorsport began unconventionally, not on the track, but behind the screen. Growing up in Guadalajara, he was captivated by the data-driven side of racing, spending hours analyzing telemetry and race strategies. After earning his degree in Computer Engineering from ITESO, he initially worked in cybersecurity, but the allure of motorsport proved too strong. He took a significant pay cut to join a smaller Mexican racing team, where he quickly proved his worth by streamlining their data infrastructure and improving race-day communication.

His methodical approach to problem-solving and meticulous attention to detail have earned him a reputation as a reliable and innovative IT professional. He believes that a robust and secure IT system is the backbone of any successful racing team. While his loyalty is unquestionable, Ricardo also possesses a strong independent streak, preferring to work autonomously and deliver results rather than engaging in office politics. He is excited to bring his unique blend of technical expertise and motorsport passion to Walkinshaw Andretti United.

At Walkinshaw Andretti United, Ricardo aims to revolutionize the team's IT infrastructure, bringing in cutting-edge technologies and ensuring seamless data flow across all departments. He is driven by a desire to contribute to the team's success by providing the technological edge needed to outperform the competition.

physical.description: Ricardo has a focused gaze and carries himself with quiet confidence.
